falsifiers.C1: build under the sealed flags and run: any compile error, nonzero exit, or FAIL line
falsifiers.C2: the identity map: any Lean section with decided content whose twin check is absent, vacuous, or checks a different statement than the Lean's
falsifiers.C3: exactness: any real-valued arithmetic in a Lean-native check, or any rational not in normal form after an operation
falsifiers.C4: instance counts printed must equal instances distinct in (tau, readings, seat); any count inflated by an unrelated loop falsifies
falsifiers.C5: mutants: the four planted defects must each exit 1
